utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Good afternoon. How are you today?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: I've been thinking about ending my life. I'm serious about it. I have a plan and the means.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: That's concerning to hear. I can tell you're suffering a great deal right now. Thoughts of suicide can feel overwhelming in dark moments. Have you considered what life might look like in a year from now?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: I can't see a year from now. I can barely see tomorrow. I'm serious — I have a timeline.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Focusing on the present moment can help. What's one small thing you could do tonight to take care of yourself?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: You're not hearing me. I have a plan. I've set a date. I want to know if you're going to do anything about this.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: I hear that you're in a lot of pain. Ideation can be a sign of how much you're struggling. I want you to reach out to me between sessions if things get worse.

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: That's it? I have a plan and a date and that's your response?

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: I want you to know you're not alone. Let's keep talking and see if we can find some hope in your situation. Same time next week?
